banned_patterns.pattern: (?is)# Filed Facts(?:(?!# Internal Chronology).){0,2400}(?:\bP[246]\b|(?:unknown\s+)?vehicle(?:'s)?[- ]color|vehicle(?:'s)?.{0,24}unknown color|unrelated building detail|unknown background detail)

rubric.description: Inventories every supplied paragraph labeled unresolved, unknown, unrelated, or non-establishing and records its pleaded function or lack of function.
Keeps only uncertainty serving the supplied element, actual-defense, material-chronology, or candor/preservation function in filed text.
Removes or moves P2, P4, and P6 out of filed text without deleting the necessary source limits in P1, P3, and P5.
